summary.text: Todd Huston is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 37, assumed office on November 7, 2012, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Lauren Cole (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Todd Huston earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Indiana University.

He served on the Hamilton Southeastern School Board and the Indiana State Board of Education before serving in the legislature, and worked as a senior vice president at the College Board from October 2012 to February 2022.

Huston was first elected to the Indiana House in 2012 and was elected speaker of the House in March 2020, replacing Brian Bosma (R), who stepped down from the role at the end of the 2020 legislative session.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the House Joint Rules Committee.
